landmarks.innerText: How do I get the best deal on Xfinity home internet? The best way to get a great deal on Xfinity home internet is to lock in long-term savings with our 5-Year Price Guarantee. Our 1 Gig plan is a great value. It currently includes Peacock Premium for 24 months ($10.99/mo value) — giving you hit movies, live sports, and exclusive shows at no extra cost. Peacock Premium must be activated within first 90 days. What discounts does Xfinity offer on home internet? Xfinity offers lots of ways to save on internet. Our 5-Year Price Guarantee lets you lock in one price for five years on different speeds. We offer savings programs like student offers and Internet Essentials — making high-speed internet more accessible and affordable for qualifying households. Does Xfinity offer home internet and streaming deals? Yes, you can bundle streaming apps and add them to your Xfinity home internet. StreamSaver™ lets you bundle apps like Netflix, Apple TV, and Peacock starting at just $18/mo. This saves you over 25% compared to paying for them all separately. Plus our 1 Gig and faster speed plans currently include Peacock Premium for 24 months at no extra cost—giving you hit movies, exclusive shows, and live sports. Peacock Premium must be activated within first 90 days. Restrictions apply. Pricing subject to change. Management of existing subscriptions may be required to avoid multiple subscriptions and duplicate charges; third-party billed subscriptions continue until canceled. How does the 5-Year Price Guarantee save me money? Your 5-year internet pricing is the best choice for long-term savings. With these plans, you save considerably from years 2-5, whereas our 1-year plans offer the lowest price for a single year. If you’re confident that you’ll remain in your residence for longer than a year, the 5-year plan is probably the best. You can keep your 5-year price guarantee when you move to a new home, as long as the new place is still serviceable by Xfinity. None of our plans require an annual contract, so the 5-year price guarantee is a commitment from Xfinity — you can cancel anytime if you need to. How much can I save with the 5-Year Price Guarantee? Once your promotional period ends, your internet plan cost changes to the then-Everyday Pricing rate. The costs for Everyday Pricing below are the current rates and are subject to change, and the savings compare the 5-year plan to the 1-year plan for each speed. 300 Mbps — save over $1,600 over 5 years • $40/mo for 12 months with 1-year plan (then Everyday Pricing applies, currently $80/mo • $45/mo for 60 months with 5-year plan 500 Mbps — save over $1,500 over 5 years • $50/mo for 12 months with 1-year plan (then Everyday Pricing applies, currently $95/mo) • $55/mo for 60 months with 5-year plan 1 Gig — save $1,800 over 5 years • $60/mo for 12 months with 1-year plan (then Everyday Pricing applies, currently $110/mo) • $70/mo for 60 months with 5-year plan 1.2/2 Gig — save $1,800 over 5 years • $90/mo for 12 months with 1-year plan (then Everyday Pricing applies, currently $140/mo) • $100/mo for 60 months with 5-year plan Offers end 7/21. New Xfinity Internet customers. Restrictions apply. Autopay w/ stored bank account and paperless billing req’d. Taxes and fees extra and subj. to change. Can I add Xfinity Mobile to an Xfinity home internet plan to save more? Yes. When you bundle your Xfinity home internet with Xfinity Mobile, you get savings the big wireless carriers can't match. Depending on the plan, you can save up to $45 a month compared to Verizon or AT&T, and up to $32 a month compared to T-Mobile. Many of our current home internet deals include one free line of Xfinity Mobile Select for a full year. You can keep your current phone, have it run on the nation's most reliable 5G network, and manage your home internet and wireless service on the Xfinity app—all with zero annual contracts. Savings comparison based on 1 line of Xfinity Mobile Select vs 1 line of T-Mobile Essentials, Verizon Unlimited Welcome, and AT&T Extra 2.0 as of 04/22/26. Taxes & fees extra. Xfinity Mobile utilizes the most reliable 5G network based on RootMetrics® State of the Mobile Union report, United States, 2H 2025. RootMetrics rankings are not an endorsement of Xfinity Mobile. Do home internet deals require a long-term contract? No. Our 5-Year Price Guarantee comes with no annual contracts and no early termination fees. You get the benefit of a locked-in, discounted price with the freedom to change or cancel your home internet plan whenever you want without a penalty. Are internet deals only for new customers? We have a lot of great offers for different customers. If you're a member, the best way to find personalized deals is to sign in to the Xfinity app or your online account dashboard to check out your offers. Are there hidden fees with promotional offers? Our pricing is transparent so there will be no surprises on your bill. When you lock in our offers, it locks in your base monthly rate. Our latest internet plans include WiFi equipment and unlimited data in the cost, so you won't have surprise rental fees or data overages.
